feet.foot: Definisi: PIF = fail; Notifikasi kosmetik = pemberitahuan kepada NPRA.
feet.clean_bm: Definisi: PIF = Fail maklumat dan bukti keselamatan kosmetik, disimpan syarikat dan ditunjukkan kepada NPRA bila diminta; Notifikasi kosmetik = Memaklumkan NPRA tentang produk kosmetik sebelum dijual. Ia bukan kelulusan.
feet.clean_en: Definition: PIF = A cosmetic's technical and safety file, kept by the company for NPRA on request; Cosmetic notification = Telling NPRA about a cosmetic product before selling it. It is not an approval.
